audit_name: Sliding Window and Evaluation Origin Audit
reason: The 36,000 rows in X_test were 3,600 spatial cells * 10 hourly transitions. Passing X_test into a 1D sequential stride of 72 rows caused evaluation windows to step across multiple spatial grid cells rather than evaluating true 72-hour temporal trajectories of a single cell.
explanation: Because the test split is 11 hours long, each test cell only possesses 10 valid transition steps (h <= 10). True 72-hour multi-step rollouts can only be evaluated when a full 72-hour continuous trajectory is supplied, such as in retrospective simulation runs or spatial cell trajectories.
correction: Differentiate cell-level evaluation across available test horizons (h=1h to 10h) from full 72h retrospective rollouts.
